comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Released from the Cargo King Mystery Bottle (7/22). This is a consumable item which, when used, gives you a choice of the male-only Sheikh's Coat, or the female-only Ikbal Dress. The stats of both outfits are identical apart from their gender restrictions.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Cargo_King_Mystery_Bottle
